keySentence: Finally, he was rich because the elves helped him.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The elves helped him. He thanked them. He was rich now. Finally, he was rich because the elves helped him.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker started with nothing but one piece of leather. The elves came every night and helped him make shoes. Finally, he was rich because the elves helped him. He showed his gratitude by making gifts for them. The lesson of this story is about kindness and thankfulness. When we help others, wonderful things happen in return.
